scientific_integrity: All claims concern the exact strongly convex proximal subproblem and are backed by an analytic proof, exact-rational direct-model checks, and the classical Li–Yorke theorem. The period-three-to-chaos implication itself is not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic scalar one-sample quadratic, positive ridge regularization, and a large constant ProxSPS model parameter; the theorem makes no assertion about stochastic trajectories, typical chaotic behavior, or a complete bifurcation diagram. A previously unindexed equivalent ProxSPS result remains possible.
title: Attracting period-three cycles and Li–Yorke chaos in exact proximal Polyak steps on strongly convex quadratics
